cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the sofa down. Are we shrinking, or is the room growing? I need your decision before I direct the move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever gets us through the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those require different methods. Shrinking means outside help; a growing room means move before the door gets farther away. Choose one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother to take the sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask him to collect us too. Please give him the full job, not just the furniture.

reason: Preserve incompatible size hypotheses and make the final correction answer B's incomplete call instruction rather than add a new tweezers prop.
